doc:
# The Lorentz group

Claims about the structure of the Lorentz group, drawn from the literature and **not yet formalized**. Overlaps `Physlib.Relativity.LorentzGroup.Basic`.

claims.name: restrictedLorentzGroup_connected
claims.statement: The restricted Lorentz group $SO^+(1,3)$ is a connected Lie group.

sources.title: The Lorentz group and its representations

claims.name: lorentzGroup_fourComponents
claims.statement: The full Lorentz group $O(1,3)$ has exactly four connected components.

claims.name: lorentzGroup_doubleCover_SL2C
claims.statement: $SL(2,\mathbb{C})$ is the universal double cover of $SO^+(1,3)$.
